what_to_detect: A spell is a playable candidate (can_play true) for its web-slinging cost: the mana is payable and its controller has a tapped creature to return.
near_miss: The web-slinging candidate is not playable (can_play false): no tapped creature to return, or the mana cannot be paid.
record_fields: decision candidate can_play, affordable, failed_checks cost (gen-3)

verdict_bit has no parameter restricting the candidate to one keyword's line or zone: with fires_when true and no restriction, any playable candidate in any decision record fires, so the detector would tag nearly every decision record.
